title_zh: 基于强化学习的代码生成提示词优化
one_line: PPO policy picks among no-edit, lexical mutation and semantic rewriting of a prompt, rewarded by unit-test pass ratio on a frozen code generator.
one_line_zh: PPO策略为提示词选择不改写、词法变异或语义重写，以测试通过率为奖励。

held_out.quote: MBPP+ (974 tasks) was split into 374 training and 500 testing tasks.

cross_task.quote: PPO policies were trained independently for each dataset–backbone configuration, using the corresponding training split and frozen code generator

improver_comparison.quote: Random-Hybrid uses the same three-action space as PPO but selects actions uniformly at random for 10 refinement steps, isolating the effect of learned action scheduling.

evidence_level.quote: Random-Hybrid uses the same three-action space as PPO but selects actions uniformly at random for 10 refinement steps, isolating the effect of learned action scheduling.

S1.quote: the shaped reward assigns proportional credit based on the fraction of passed test cases at each step, with additional penalties for execution failures

S3.quote: After a transformation is applied, the updated prompt is passed to a frozen code generation model to produce executable code.

S4.quote: The action space includes three actions: (1) Direct Generation, which preserves the current prompt, (2) genetic algorithm–based lexical mutation inspired by EPiC

S5.quote: PPO policies were trained independently for each dataset–backbone configuration, using the corresponding training split and frozen code generator

F1.quote: The contribution lies in coordinating reinforcement learning, genetic prompt mutation, and semantic rewriting through a learned sequential policy for executable code generation.

F2.quote: The proposed framework learns to select between lexical mutation and semantic rewriting based on intermediate test feedback.

title_zh: CODESKILL：为编码智能体学习自进化技能
one_line: RL-trained small model extracts, evolves and prunes a coding skill bank, rewarded by rubric quality and a frozen agent's with-versus-without-skill verifier gain.
one_line_zh: 强化学习训练小模型管理技能库，奖励结合质量评分与冻结智能体有无技能的增益。

held_out.quote: Since EnvBench and SWE-Bench Verified are also used for training, we use disjoint held-out splits for evaluation.

cross_task.quote: Terminal-Bench 2 is not used during training, and serves as an out-of-distribution benchmark for testing whether the learned skill-management policy generalizes to new coding-agent tasks.

optimizer_cost.quote: Future work could extend this framework to strictly streaming task settings and evaluate the end-to-end cost of skill acquisition, maintenance, and use.

retained_ablation.quote: Compared with the no-skill baseline, CODESKILL improves average pass rate from 29.32 to 40.35, showing the benefit of managed procedural skills for downstream coding agents.

improver_comparison.quote: First, we evaluate prompt-based skill-management pipelines that use the same operation space as CODESKILL but replace the learned policy with fixed prompts and heuristic decisions.

leakage_guard.quote: During final evaluation, we exclude any skill whose provenance includes the current test instance to prevent access to knowledge derived from that instance.

evidence_level.quote: First, we evaluate prompt-based skill-management pipelines that use the same operation space as CODESKILL but replace the learned policy with fixed prompts and heuristic decisions.

S1.quote: define the execution reward as the verifier improvement over the no-skill baseline

S2.quote: We therefore define an execution reward by comparing the frozen coding policy’s performance with and without the generated skill.

S3.quote: We therefore use an alignment factor to judge whether the rollout actually matches the skill trigger condition and follows its workflow or constraints

S5.quote: allowing a single CODESKILL model to manage skills across different SWE tasks

F2.quote: CODESKILL learns a policy for managing a skill bank

F3.quote: We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy.

F4.quote: This attribution-aware design combines dense quality supervision with baseline-relative execution feedback, gated by behavioral evidence of skill use.

title_zh: ExpHarness：通过可训练外壳实现与执行器无关的经验学习
one_line: RL-trained retrieval copilot sets graph-search breadth and utility weighting over an evolving experience graph; reward is with-minus-without-experience score, also updating node utilities.
one_line_zh: 强化学习检索副驾驶控制经验图检索广度与效用权重，奖励为有无经验得分差。

optimizer_cost.quote: Step counts describe environment interaction and do not include all retrieval, LLM inference, or training costs; they can also vary with task success.

retained_ablation.quote: (i) No-Memory directly uses the frozen executor without external experiences.

evidence_level.quote: On ExpSuite-Static, ExpHarness improves the test-instance-weighted average score over MemRL, the strongest baseline under this aggregation, by 12.1% with the small executor and 4.5% with the large executor.

S1.quote: The score difference records the observed change relative to the no-experience run, while adds an absolute-performance term.

S2.quote: This objective trains retrieval controls using downstream task scores rather than semantic similarity alone.

S3.quote: The same reward also updates the experience graph, so that both halves of the harness co-evolve from a single signal.

F2.quote: ExpHarness trains a lightweight retrieval copilot to control how the graph is searched.

title_zh: SkillComposer：学习进化智能体技能以兼顾特化与泛化
one_line: A small model is SFT-trained on delta-pass-rate rejection-sampled data to create, improve and merge skills, used offline, online or hybrid for frozen executors.
one_line_zh: 小模型用通过率增量拒绝采样数据微调，学会创建、改进、合并技能，供冻结执行器使用。

held_out.quote: We use AppWorld as an out-of-distribution evaluation to assess cross-task generalization, as it is entirely unseen during training.

improver_comparison.quote: SkillComposer online improves over its untrained counterpart by 2.0 points on -Bench and 2.4 points on LiveCodeBench, confirming that rejection-sampling-based training yields meaningful quality gains.

evidence_level.quote: SkillComposer online improves over its untrained counterpart by 2.0 points on -Bench and 2.4 points on LiveCodeBench, confirming that rejection-sampling-based training yields meaningful quality gains.

S1.quote: A training example is accepted only when the candidate improves the executor’s pass@ relative to the appropriate baseline by at least a threshold .

title_zh: OPD-Evolver：通过在线策略蒸馏培养整体型智能体进化者
one_line: A single policy selects, uses, writes and maintains a four-tier memory; on-policy self-distillation from an outcome-attributed privileged teacher internalises these four abilities.

title_zh: SkillRise：面向跨任务技能进化的智能体强化学习

title_zh: Harness-R1：从智能体失败轨迹中学习编辑可执行运行时外壳
